column1: # dots-icons: Phosphor glyphs as a monospace fallback font, for the places where only a
# CHARACTER renders -- starship, tmux, fzf headers, otter-launcher. Waybar is GTK and takes
# the real SVGs via -gtk-icontheme(), so it is deliberately not served from here.
# Codepoints live in PLANE 16 (U+100000-U+10FFFD), supplementary private use area B.
# Nerd Font uses U+E000-F8FF and U+F0000-FFFFD and never touches plane 16, so our range can
# never collide with a glyph the lint rule bans -- and lint allowlists exactly this block.
# glyph turns muddy at 9pt and rebuild -- nothing else has to change.
# Waybar is GTK and could take SVGs via -gtk-icontheme(), but its format-icons are
# STRINGS, so the font is what actually reaches them. Fill = on, regular = off, per
# the same convention the icon theme uses.
